a270c859c7.q: How does WebMCP help AI agents interact more precisely with website forms and e-commerce features?
a270c859c7.a: Google released WebMCP as structured data for websites, allowing sites to mark up their pages using APIs so that when Google adds agent features, agents know exactly where to click to submit forms, create reservations, add to carts, or complete checkouts. Without WebMCP, agents rely on HTML and are okay but not great at these actions; WebMCP makes them much more precise in interfacing with sites.
